ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data

promise_gap: Ad: 'get a 3.82 kW solar system at a 3 kW package price, with eligible government subsidy benefits and extra energy discounts.'

The site's own calculator defaults to a 4 kW system at Rs.2,80,000 with a Rs.78,000 subsidy and a -Rs.35,000 discount, landing at Rs.1,67,000 net. The numbers exist and are close - but the click never reaches them, because the ad lands on an fb.me lead form (confirmed on the card).
Ad: 'Want to know how much you can save? Enquire now.'

The JSON-LD publishes info@hindusthansolarenergy.com and +91-8712636576, and the site shows tel:+918712636576 at all seven branches, so the promise is backed on the page - it is simply never seen by paid traffic.

The JSON-LD describes the business as a 'PM Surya Ghar approved Solar EPC installer... 1.4 MW+ of verified rooftop solar capacity with 25-year performance warranty'. The subsidy claim rests on the approved-installer status, not on an on-page subsidy table.
